answer: For votes on vine removal from a knoll in sable habitat, I propose one monthly ballot per key. Each key escrows 100 native coins and burns 5 additional coins monthly. A contract verifies deposits and burns, rejects repeat ballots, and delays withdrawals 90 days after exit. No deposit can back two keys: n active keys lock 100n coins and consume 5n monthly. Missing payment blocks voting. This prices extra identities rather than proving unique humans; wealthy sponsors can buy many, coin values vary, and poorer residents may be excluded.
